einzeiler: Mike Lee discusses the making and themes of his 1993 classic film Naked
kurzfassung: Filmmaker Mike Lee reflects on the creation of his 1993 feature Naked in a conversation moderated by Madeline Whittle. He discusses his extensive rehearsal process, his close collaboration with lead actor David Thewlis, and the complex motivations behind the protagonist Johnny. Additionally, Lee addresses the film's reception, its visual style, and its enduring thematic resonance.
stichpunkte: Collaboration with David Thewlis built upon previous roles and extensive character development
Johnny serves as a receptacle for various societal frustrations and intellectual preoccupations
The character of Johnny reflects a lamentation on the shortcomings of the education system
Lee rejects the label of misogyny for the protagonist, contrasting him with clearly malicious characters
The film balances dark themes and despair with organic moments of humor and tenderness
Cinematographer Dick Pope utilized bleach bypass to achieve the nocturnal, desaturated visual style
Musical scoring by Andrew Dixon was developed collaboratively after shooting, featuring unique harp instrumentation
Lee maintains his unique collaborative process, constructing scripts through unscripted actor improvisations

clips.hook: An early school memory tied to the millennium
clips.text: The director recalls an elementary school headmaster predicting a total solar eclipse for 1999, a distant event that ultimately influenced the protagonist's mindset.

clips.hook: Finding comedy in the darkest moments
clips.text: The filmmaker points out the inherent absurdity of human existence by noting that even at funerals, people inevitably find moments to laugh.

clips.hook: The irony of receiving a retrospective without funding
clips.text: The director highlights the contradiction of celebrating past work while struggling to secure financial backing for new film projects.
Reflecting on his early training at RADA in London during the 1960s, the filmmaker describes the institution as rigid, uncreative, and entirely unexploratory.
The process of finding the right musical voice led the team to spend a day surrounded by numerous harps inside a prominent musician's unconventional home.

beschreibung:
This week we’re excited to present a conversation from 2022 with the great British filmmaker Mike Leigh as he discusses his 1993 film: the NYFF31 selection Naked. Mike Leigh returns to the New York Film Festival with his final film, Tender Loving Care, at the 64th New York Film Festival this September and October. Secure your seats with an NYFF64 Pass at filmlinc.org/passes

The acclaimed winner of the 1996 Cannes Film Festival’s Palme d’Or, Mike Leigh’s mid-’90s masterpiece cemented his status as the poet laureate of modern family life. The story concerns Cynthia (Brenda Blethyn, awarded Best Actress at Cannes), a working-class white woman whose personal and interpersonal lives are transformed when she learns that a Black optometrist is the child she gave up for adoption 27 years prior. Created, like Leigh’s other films, after long months of intensely collaborative improvisation, Secrets & Lies is remarkable for its lived-in warmth and humor, and above all for its unflinching honesty in capturing the everyday evasions and deceptions that can define our lives.
